preconditions.description: The number of stations n is between 3 and 3000 inclusive.
The number of passages is equal to the number of stations n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n for xi, yi in passages)
preconditions.description: Each station in the passages is numbered between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(xi != yi for xi, yi in passages)
preconditions.description: No passage connects a station to itself.

preconditions.expression: len(set((min(xi, yi), max(xi, yi)) for xi, yi in passages)) == n
preconditions.description: Each pair of stations is connected by at most one passage.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n distances, one for each station.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(d, int) and d >= 0 for d in distances)
postconditions.description: Each distance is a non-negative integer.
At least one station is on the ringroad (distance 0).

postconditions.expression: all(d == 0 or d > 0 for d in distances)
postconditions.description: Stations not on the ringroad have a positive distance.
